plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Extreme Networks VDX / SLX data-center switches (ex-Brocade, enterprise PEN 1588, BROCADE-MODULE-CPU-UTIL-MIB / BROCADE-MODULE-MEM-UTIL-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports per-module (slot) CPU utilization (5-minute average) and memory utilization, total and available memory.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Per-module CPU utilization of the Extreme VDX / SLX switch as a 0-100 percentage, from BROCADE-MODULE-CPU-UTIL-MIB bcsiModuleCpuUtil100thPercent (1.3.6.1.4.1.1588.3.1.12.1.1.1.3). Only the 300-second (5-minute) average is kept; the Gauge32 value is divided by 100 in the collector. Slot numbering follows the MIB (MM1=1, MM2=2, LC1=3, ...).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Per-module memory capacity in bytes of the Extreme VDX / SLX switch, from BROCADE-MODULE-MEM-UTIL-MIB bcsiModuleMemTotal (1.3.6.1.4.1.1588.3.1.13.1.1.1.2). The MIB reports kiloBytes; the collector multiplies by 1024. Values of 0 or below are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Per-module available memory in bytes of the Extreme VDX / SLX switch, from BROCADE-MODULE-MEM-UTIL-MIB bcsiModuleMemAvailable (1.3.6.1.4.1.1588.3.1.13.1.1.1.3). The MIB reports kiloBytes; the collector multiplies by 1024. Values below 0 or larger than total are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Per-module memory utilization of the Extreme VDX / SLX switch as a 0-100 percentage, from BROCADE-MODULE-MEM-UTIL-MIB bcsiModuleMemUtil100thPercent (1.3.6.1.4.1.1588.3.1.13.1.1.1.4). The Gauge32 value is divided by 100 in the collector. Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
